Mosquito Control and Tick Control Hingham MA

Mosquito Squad of Boston Metro South, trusted and guaranteed effective mosquito control and tick control in Hingham, Mass.

Hingham, MA, located in the South Shore area, is lauded as one of the best places to live in all of Massachusetts. With lots of suburban residences, and parks in which to spend time, there too lies the risk ofticks andmosquitoes in search of their next blood meal.

Mosquito Control Services in Hingham, Mass.

At Mosquito Squad, our mosquito control services are not made up of a simple barrier treatment spray application. Our Hingham mosquito control specialists know how to spot a nasty mosquito reproductive habitat. What’s more, they know how to greatly reduce their numbers! They will show you areas of concern, help you rid your yard of them, and treat the area for mosquitoes with our tried and trusted mosquito barrier protection spray. Like clockwork, a technician will return to your home every 14 to 21 days to reapply your mosquito control spray to help keep you protected.

Tick Control in Hingham, MA

We address your Hingham tick concerns exactly the same way as your mosquito problems. Our unfailing tick control methodology is in place to help eliminate breeding tick habitats, as well as places that ticks lie in wait for their next victim. We do this through our periodic barrier treatment sprays in peak tick season, as well as our tick tubes throughout the tick diapause, or hibernation season. Namely, late fall and winter. This means your home and family will remain protected all year long.

We know that regular Hingham tick and mosquito control clients, as well as those who are not clients, need mosquito and tick protection for outdoor events and special occasions. Outdoor Pest Control in Hingham, MA

When you want to finally enjoy your yard and other outdoor spaces without fear of pests or disruption, we can help! Yard Defender is our comprehensive outdoor pest control solution that offers protection beyond just mosquitoes and ticks. It also helps reduce spider, ant, flea, gnat, and stink bug populations in your yard. 

It works by targeting the places in your backyard where pests tend to gather, such as shaded areas, standing water, and dense vegetation. We treat these spots and your perimeter with EPA-registered products to help create a protective barrier around your home. It’s highly effective, yet simple, and helps give you the protection you need throughout the season.

Hingham Pest Control for Your Home

When pests begin invading your home, it’s time to bring in the pros. Home Shield is the signature indoor pest control solution that we use to help protect your home against common invaders. It controls spiders, ants, cockroaches, centipedes, and other crawling pests that you don’t want to come across inside the sanctuary that is your home.

It always starts with a thorough inspection to identify entry points we can seal up. Then, we’ll target the foundations, gaps, eaves, and entry points with our EPA-registered products. It focuses on exterior treatments, eliminating the need for indoor sprays or foggers, and offers lasting protection because of our 3-week treatment cycles.

Hingham Rodent Control for Your Home

Rodents are a tougher pest to remove from your home because once they’re inside, they’ll make themselves comfortable. You see, most rats and mice seek shelter in homes during the cooler months to escape the frigid temperatures, and will get inside through the tiniest gaps. 

That’s why our rodent control service with Home Shield includes property inspection, exclusion methods, and treatments with EPA-registered products, so we can not only help remove rodents but also help prevent more from entering. Throughout the season, we’ll come back every three weeks to check our work and reapply our treatments.

Mosquito & Pest FAQs

Will Mosquito Squad kill all pests on my Boston Metro South property?

Our highly trained technicians use EPA-registered products to drastically reduce the number of pests you see. While we cannot promise to eliminate all the pests on your property, we are happy to re-treat your property at no additional charge within 21 days of your treatment. Check out our 100% satisfaction guarantee for more information.

How much does Boston Metro South pest control cost?

Pest control pricing in Boston Metro South can vary based on the size of your property, the type of pests, and the treatment plan you choose. To view current package options and pricing, scroll to the top of this page, you’ll find all the details listed there.

Do I need to be home during mosquito treatments in Boston Metro South?

No. And we'll leave a notice so you know we completed your requested service.

Does Mosquito Squad offer natural or eco-friendly pest control options in Boston Metro South?

Yes, Mosquito Squad offers a natural mosquito treatment option in Boston Metro South for customers seeking eco-friendly solutions. Our natural treatment is made with essential oils and provides effective mosquito control while being gentle on the environment. While it doesn’t last quite as long as our traditional barrier treatment, it’s a great choice for families who prefer a more natural approach.

Are ticks a problem in Boston Metro South?

Yes, ticks can be a significant concern in Boston Metro South, especially during warmer months. These tiny pests thrive in wooded areas, tall grasses, and even well-maintained yards. Ticks are more than just a nuisance, they can carry serious diseases like Lyme disease and Rocky Mountain spotted fever. If you spend time outdoors or have pets, it's important to take preventive measures and consider professional tick control services to reduce the risk of bites and infestations.

What attracts pests to my home in Boston Metro South?

Pests are drawn to homes in Boston Metro South by food, water, and shelter. Common attractants include standing water, uncovered trash, pet food, cluttered yards, and small entry points around your home. Keeping your property clean and sealed can help reduce pest activity.

What are no-see-ums and are they a problem in Boston Metro South?

No-see-ums are tiny biting midges that are often found in warm, humid areas. Despite their small size, their bites can be painful and itchy. They’re especially active around dawn and dusk and can be a nuisance in yards, patios, and near water. If you're noticing bites but can't see the culprit, no-see-ums might be the cause.

How can I get rid of flies around my Boston Metro South property?

To reduce flies around your Boston Metro South property, eliminate attractants like uncovered trash, pet waste, and standing water. Keep doors and windows sealed, and use screens to block entry.

Does Mosquito Squad offer pest control for special events in Boston Metro South?

Yes! Mosquito Squad provides one-time pest control treatments for outdoor events in Boston Metro South, including weddings, parties, reunions, and more. Our special event service helps keep mosquitoes and other pests away so your guests can enjoy the occasion comfortably.
